Poland Warns of Russian Drone/Missile Attack on NATO Country

Poland has stated that Russian President Vladimir Putin is planning to launch a drone or missile attack on a NATO country. The Independent reported that drones are targeting UK military sites almost daily, indicating a growing threat from Putin. The Daily Telegraph identified these as "Geran-5" super drones, describing them as a serious threat to NATO. Russian officials have claimed election results will show widespread support for the war in Ukraine, while both Russian and Ukrainian officials are reportedly attempting to remove Steve Witkoff from US-led negotiations.
